what: The evaluator's bench as the garage's workshop stands it: its report's ten check lamps, V1 to V10, lit where the check passed and hatched where it was skipped.

code.note: packages/world as on main (base), plus the rig named here: the garage's own builders (stations/garage/bays.ts, workshop.ts) from the frame data, with the rig's camera and the stage's dark ground

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.agent-evaluator --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max

png_1280.size: 1280 x 720, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_640.size: 640 x 360, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: the garage's workshop (stations/garage/workshop.ts), the rig, or the frame data changes
